products.name: Watercolour Painting Masterclass
products.description: An immersive half-day watercolour session exploring loose, expressive mark-making. Participants work from still-life arrangements using professional-grade pigments and cold-press paper. Suitable for all levels.
products.cultural_benefits: Builds patience, creative confidence and fine motor skills. Connects participants to a tradition of British landscape painting rooted in the region.

products.name: Watercolour Painting - Complete Starter Kit
products.description: A curated set of professional watercolour supplies: 24-pigment pan set, two cold-press pads (A4 & A3), three kolinsky sable brushes, and a colour-mixing guide booklet. Perfect for home practice after a workshop.
products.cultural_benefits: Encourages continued creative practice at home. Supports local arts suppliers and reduces barriers to entry for aspiring painters.

products.name: Life Drawing Open Session
products.description: A weekly open studio life drawing event with a professional model and optional tutor feedback. All media welcome - pencil, charcoal, ink. Easels and drawing boards provided.
products.cultural_benefits: Develops observational drawing skills and body-positive art education. Creates a safe, inclusive creative community space.

products.name: Community Mural Design Commission
products.description: Verdigris Studio designs and paints a bespoke community mural for public or semi-public spaces. Includes community consultation sessions, concept design, and a two-day paint installation.
products.cultural_benefits: Transforms public spaces with culturally meaningful imagery. Engages local residents in collaborative storytelling through visual art.

products.name: Pottery Throwing Taster Session
products.description: Get hands on the wheel in this 2-hour introductory pottery session. Learn to centre, open and pull clay into a small vessel. Firing and collection included in the price.
products.cultural_benefits: Connects participants to one of humanity's oldest craft traditions. Develops tactile creativity and mindfulness through making.

products.name: Hand-Thrown Ceramic Vase - Painted Edition
products.description: A signed, hand-thrown stoneware vase painted in a traditional botanical motif by Verdigris Studio artists. Each piece is one-of-a-kind, food safe, and kiln-fired to 1260┬░C.
products.cultural_benefits: Supports local ceramic craft tradition. Brings hand-made artisanal goods into everyday domestic life.

products.name: Open Mic Night - Monthly Event
products.description: A curated open mic evening at a local venue, hosting up to 20 performers across spoken word, comedy, original music, and experimental performance. Doors open at 7 pm, first act at 7:30.
products.cultural_benefits: Provides a platform for emerging local voices and performers. Builds community through live shared cultural experience.

products.name: Youth Drama & Devising Programme
products.description: A 10-week after-school drama programme for ages 13-18. Participants devise, rehearse, and perform an original short piece at a public showcase. No experience necessary.
products.cultural_benefits: Develops communication, teamwork and self-expression in young people. Keeps youth engaged with live performance and storytelling.

products.name: Community Theatre Production - Spring Season
products.description: Amplify Arts presents its biannual community theatre production. Ticket includes the performance, programme, and a post-show discussion with the cast and director.
products.cultural_benefits: Brings high-quality theatre to local communities. Celebrates shared cultural narratives and regional stories.

products.name: Butterfly Contemporary Dance Workshop
products.description: A two-hour contemporary dance workshop exploring movement inspired by natural forms. Suitable for all abilities - no dance experience required. Led by award-winning choreographer Lola Eze.
products.cultural_benefits: Promotes physical wellbeing alongside cultural participation. Explores movement as a language of cultural expression.

products.name: The Byrd Theatre Experience - Premium Ticket
products.description: A premium seated ticket for Amplify Arts's flagship evening performance at The Byrd Theatre, including reserved seating, programme, and post-show champagne reception.
products.cultural_benefits: Celebrates the live theatre tradition. Connects audiences to outstanding regional performance in a historic venue.

products.name: Professional Stage Lighting Hire
products.description: Hire Amplify Arts's professional LED stage lighting rig for your community event or performance. Includes setup, operation, and breakdown by a qualified technician.
products.cultural_benefits: Enables smaller community groups to stage professional-quality events. Builds technical capacity in the local arts sector.

products.name: Self-Publishing Masterclass
products.description: A full-day intensive workshop covering every stage of self-publishing: manuscript preparation, cover design briefing, formatting, ISBN registration, print-on-demand distribution, and marketing your book.
products.cultural_benefits: Democratises publishing and amplifies marginalised voices. Supports the creation of local literary culture.

products.name: Hand-Stitched Zine - Collector's Edition
products.description: A limited run of 50 hand-stitched zines produced by Inkwell Press, curating poetry, illustration, and essays by Hertfordshire-based creatives. Each copy individually numbered and signed.
products.cultural_benefits: Celebrates grassroots print culture. Provides a tangible cultural artefact by and for the local community.

products.name: The Picture of Dorian Gray - Annotated Study Edition
products.description: A beautifully typeset annotated edition of Oscar Wilde's classic novel, with critical essays, historical context, and original illustrations commissioned by Inkwell Press.
products.cultural_benefits: Encourages engagement with classic literature and its cultural legacy. Connects readers to themes of identity, art, and society.

products.name: The Great Gatsby - Limited Folio Edition
products.description: A premium folio-format edition of F. Scott Fitzgerald's The Great Gatsby, printed on laid paper, cloth-bound, with a ribbon marker and slipcase. A statement collector's piece.
products.cultural_benefits: Promotes literary appreciation and reading culture. A beautiful physical artefact celebrating great storytelling.

products.name: Monthly Poetry & Prose Reading Circle
products.description: A facilitated monthly literary gathering exploring a different text each session. Includes a reading, guided discussion, and optional creative writing response exercise. Tea and biscuits provided.
products.cultural_benefits: Fosters deep reading habits and community dialogue. Creates an accessible intellectual and social space for all.

products.name: St Albans Roman Heritage Walk
products.description: A two-hour guided walking tour of St Albans' Roman heritage, taking in Verulamium Park, the Roman mosaic floors, the hypocaust remains, and the city walls. Led by a qualified historian.
products.cultural_benefits: Connects residents to the deep history of their locality. Builds civic pride and historical literacy.

products.name: York Shambles & Medieval Streets Guided Experience
products.description: A curated experience recreating the atmosphere of a medieval market street, visiting preserved historic buildings, learning about craft guilds, and sampling heritage foods. Available as a day trip.
products.cultural_benefits: Brings medieval history to life through immersive storytelling. Deepens understanding of British urban heritage.

products.name: Gothic Architecture & Mystery Trail
products.description: An atmospheric evening heritage trail exploring Gothic architecture in the local area, weaving in folklore, legend, and architectural history. Lantern provided.
products.cultural_benefits: Illuminates hidden layers of local cultural history. Engages participants in narrative-driven heritage exploration.

products.name: Brand Identity Design Package
products.description: Full brand identity development for a cultural organisation or creative SME: strategy session, logo suite (primary, secondary, icon), colour palette, typography guide, and brand usage document. Delivered in 3 weeks.
products.cultural_benefits: Elevates the visual presence of local cultural organisations. Enables SMEs to compete professionally in a crowded marketplace.

products.name: Brand Mood Board & Visual Strategy Session
products.description: A half-day brand positioning and mood board workshop for cultural businesses. Pixel & Thread's creative team works with you to define your visual direction, audience, and tone.
products.cultural_benefits: Gives small cultural businesses the strategic tools to communicate their identity effectively.

products.name: Event Photography - Full Day Coverage
products.description: Professional event photography for cultural events, festivals, and community gatherings. Includes a fully edited gallery of 200+ images delivered within 5 working days.
products.cultural_benefits: Creates a lasting visual record of community cultural moments. Supports documentation of local arts and heritage events.

products.name: Graphic Design Retainer - Monthly
products.description: A monthly graphic design retainer providing up to 20 hours of design support: social media graphics, posters, flyers, and digital assets for cultural organisations and SMEs.
products.cultural_benefits: Gives cultural organisations consistent, professional visual communications without full-time design costs.

products.name: High-End Exhibition Display Furniture - Hire
products.description: Hire Pixel & Thread's curated collection of high-end display furniture for exhibitions and cultural events: pedestals, vitrines, gallery benches, and mobile screens.
products.cultural_benefits: Enables community galleries and pop-up cultural events to present work at a professional standard.
products.size_quantity: Per item per event, see pricing

products.name: High-End Ceramic Display Plinth - Purchase
products.description: A beautifully crafted solid oak display plinth, ideal for sculpture, ceramics, or cultural artefacts. Available in three heights (30cm, 60cm, 90cm). Finished in raw, waxed, or painted white.
products.cultural_benefits: Enhances the presentation of cultural and artistic objects in homes and public spaces.

products.name: Digital Illustration Portrait - Commission
products.description: Signal & Noise creates a bespoke editorial-style digital illustration portrait, inspired by your brief, delivered as a high-resolution print-ready file and web-optimised version.
products.cultural_benefits: Celebrates personal identity through a contemporary art form. Supports local digital artists in sustaining a creative practice.

products.name: Digital Illustration Workshop - Introduction
products.description: A beginner's digital illustration workshop using Procreate on iPad. Participants learn brushwork, layers, colour theory, and composition. iPads provided. Take your artwork home digitally.
products.cultural_benefits: Opens digital creative tools to new audiences. Builds digital literacy alongside artistic skills.

products.name: Podcast Production - Full Episode Package
products.description: End-to-end podcast production for cultural organisations: pre-production planning, studio recording (up to 2 hrs), professional editing, sound design, and mastered audio delivered in 48 hrs.
products.cultural_benefits: Amplifies cultural voices and stories to digital audiences. Supports the growth of local content creation.
products.size_quantity: Per episode, up to 2 hr raw

products.name: Animation Storyboard Commission
products.description: Signal & Noise produces a full storyboard for a short animation project (up to 2 minutes): brief consultation, pencil thumbnails, refined digital storyboard panels, and animatic.
products.cultural_benefits: Supports the creation of animated cultural content and visual storytelling. Builds capacity for digital arts production.

products.name: Content Creation Subscription - 3 Months
products.description: Three months of social content creation for cultural organisations: 12 posts/month across Instagram and Facebook, including photography, short video reels, and caption copywriting.
products.cultural_benefits: Sustains digital engagement between in-person events. Helps cultural organisations grow local and regional audiences.
